t: Background Character Sketch On Dr. Heitor Da-Silveira Carneiro, Brazilian Vice Consul

C.l.Ms. 123/39.
C. SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
S. REG.
APRIL B. D. 8170 41.
Re Dr. Heitor da-Silveira Carneiro, Brazilian Vice-Consul.

D.I. Crighton Supt. Duncan.

Sir,

On July 27th 1939, information was supplied by the
U. S. A. Court Marshal to the effect that one Nathan Rabin was
improperly using diplomatic Licence plates No.47 issued to Dr.
Heitor da-Silveira Carneiro, Vice Consul for Brasil, and as a
result, that gentleman was interviewed by Detective Sergeant
Rhodes of Crime Branch Headquarters on the morning of July 28th.
1939.

As result of this interview Dr. Carneiro explained that
sometime about the beginning of July 1939, he decided to sell
his m/car, as he was shortly being transferred to Antwerp, and
Rabin whom he had known for some time previous, presented himself
as a prospective buyer on behalf of the Japanese Gendarmerie.
At this time no definite decision was made and for some time
after this Rabin was permitted the use of the m/car along with
the diplomatic licence plates in order that he might try out
the engine etc.

On July 27th 1939 the Political Section of the French
Police communicated with Dr. Carneiro relative to an infringement
of Traffic Regulations and this he claims was the first time
that he was aware that Rabin was daily using his car for the
purpose of visiting various night clubs etc.

He explained the above circumstances to the French
Police, and forthwith had the car placed in Mark. L. Moody's Garage
at same time removing the licence plates therefrom.

Although the Vice Consul maintained that it was as a
prospective buyer that Rabin had been given the use of the car,
reliable information received at that time indicated that the

1941年4月 B. D. 8170号。
事由：巴西副领事海托尔·达席尔瓦·卡内罗博士（Dr. Heitor da-Silveira Carneiro）。

督察长邓肯致克里顿督察。

先生：

1939年7月27日，美国法院法警提供情报称，一名纳森·拉宾（Nathan Rabin）不当使用了发给巴西副领事海托尔·达席尔瓦·卡内罗博士的外交车牌第47号。因此，刑事部总部的罗德侦探警长于1939年7月28日上午约谈了这位绅士。

在此次约谈中，卡内罗博士解释说，大约在1939年7月初，他决定出售其汽车，因为他即将被调往安特卫普。此前与他相识一段时间的拉宾以日本宪兵队潜在买家的身份出现。当时并未做出明确决定，在此后的一段时间里，拉宾获准使用该汽车及外交车牌，以便试驾引擎等部件。

1939年7月27日，法国警察政治处就违反交通法规一事与卡内罗博士联系，他声称这是第一次得知拉宾每天使用他的汽车去各种夜总会等地。

他向法国警方解释了上述情况，并随即把车停放在马克·L·穆迪（Mark. L. Moody）的车库，同时取下了车牌。

尽管这位副领事坚持称拉宾是作为潜在买家而获准使用该车，但当时收到的可靠情报表明，

car was handed over to Rabin in payment of a $14,000.00 gambling
debt incurred by the Vice Consul.

The Vice Consul was instructed that Special plates are
for the use of Consular officials only and that should he have
no further use for them he must return same to the Police.

In reference to the rearrest of Edward Thomas Riley, it
is worthy of note that at the time of him being taken to the
offices of the U.S.A. Court Marshal he requested that the
undersigned, and Mr. S. Titlebaum immediately accompany him to
the home of Dr. H. Carneiro, where he alleged the latter was
keeping for him the following sums of money:-

U.S.$16,000.00 and S.C.$51,000.00,

which he stated he had given to Dr. Carneiro sometime in December
1940 shortly after his escape from custody.

He further mentioned that since his escape he had visited
Carneiro on numerous occasions and several times spent the night
at this man's home.

His request was refused at this time, and when Dr.
Carneiro subsequently refused to hand over the money "Riley"
again in the presence of witnesses stated "If you people had
gone with me the first time to Carneiro's home we would have
found the money hidden in the bathroom."

The money in question was subsequently paid to Riley's
Attorney on the afternoon of 3.4.41 and amongst the money paid
was a Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation cheque for
U.S.$9,000.00 signed by Dr. Carneiro.

该车是交给拉宾以抵偿副领事所欠的14,000.00美元赌债。

已指示该副领事，特别车牌仅供领事官员使用，如果他不再需要使用，必须将其交还警方。

关于爱德华·托马斯·莱利（Edward Thomas Riley）再次被捕一事，值得注意的是，在他被带往美国法院法警办公室时，他请求在下文署名者及S·泰特尔鲍姆（S. Titlebaum）先生立即陪同他前往H·卡内罗博士家中，他声称后者为他保管着以下款项：

16,000.00美元和51,000.00元（中国货币），

他称这些钱是他在1940年12月逃脱拘押后不久交给卡内罗博士的。

他还提到，自逃脱以来，他多次拜访卡内罗，并数次在该人家中过夜。

当时他的请求被拒绝，后来当卡内罗博士拒绝交出这笔钱时，“莱利”再次在证人面前声称：“如果你们第一次就跟我一起去卡内罗家，我们就会找到藏在浴室里的钱。”

随后，有关款项于1941年4月3日下午支付给了莱利的律师，其中支付的款项包括一张由卡内罗博士签名的汇丰银行支票，金额为9,000.00美元。

（批注：7. " #!）

HEADQUARTERS CRIME BRANCH
C. MISCELLANEOUS FILE
No. 123/39
Date 29/7/39

D. C. S. C. Branch
C.I, C.Bellew. 8270
July 29, 39

Improper use of Special Licence plates.

D.S. Rhodes D.I. Glover

Sir,

With reference to the letter received from the
U.S. Marshal for China regarding Nathan Rabin owning and
driving a motor car bearing Special Licence plates No.47,
which plates are officially allocated to the Brazilian Consul,
I beg to report that during the forenoon of July 28th. 1939,
the undersigned interviewed Mr. Heitor-da Silveira Carnerio
Vice Consul for Brazil relative to the improper use of diplomatic
licence plates.

He stated that about the begining of July 1939 he
decided to sell his car, and Rabin who he was more or less
friendly with presented himself as a prospective buyer,
claiming that he wished to purchase the car on behalf of the
Japanese Special Service Section, by whom he - Rabin - is
employed.

No definite decision was reached at that time, but
the Vice Consul allowed Rabin the use of the car complete with
the Special plates whenever he required it and a definite
answer was to be given by 4 p.m. July 28th. 1939 as to whether
he was satisfied with the machine or not.

On July 27th. 1939 the Political Section, French
Police communicated with the Vice Consul relative to an
infringement of traffic regulations, this he claims was the
first time he had knowledge that Rabin was daily using the
car to visit various night clubs etc.

He explained the circumstances to the French Police
and forthwith had the car placed in Moody's garage and removed
the license plates therefrom.

because he has been transferred to Antwerp and expects to le-

1939年7月29日

不当使用特别车牌。

罗德侦探警长 格洛弗督察

先生：

兹就收到关于纳森·拉宾拥有并驾驶一辆挂有特别车牌第47号的汽车一事来函，该车牌正式配发给巴西领事，谨此报告，1939年7月28日上午，下文署名者就外交车牌的不当使用问题，约谈了巴西副领事海托尔·达席尔瓦·卡内罗先生。

他表示，大约在1939年7月初，他决定出售其汽车，与他关系尚可的拉宾以潜在买家的身份出现，声称希望代表日本特务机关购买该车，拉宾受雇于该机关。

当时未达成明确决定，但副领事允许拉宾在需要时使用带有特别车牌的汽车，并约定在1939年7月28日下午4点前给出明确答复，说明他对车辆是否满意。

1939年7月27日，法国警察政治处就违反交通法规一事与副领事联系，他声称这是第一次得知拉宾每天使用该车去各种夜总会等地。

他向法国警方解释了情况，并随即把车停放在穆迪的车库，并取下了车牌。

他解释说，卖车的原因是他已被调往安特卫普，预计不久将离

Shanghai to take up his new post at an early date.
Although the Vice Consul maintained that it was
as a prospective buyer that Rabin used the car, information
to hand reveals that the car was handed over to Rabin by
the Vice Consul to liquidate heavy gambling debts, and for
which reason he is also being removed from Shanghai.

（批：the amount involved is alleged to be $14,000.00 17.6.3）

Since Rabin has been deprived the use of the car,
he has declared to friends that within a very short time he
will still own the car, and same will carry S.D.F. plates.
The Vice Consul has been instructed that the
Special plates are for the use of Consulars officials only
and that should he have no further use for them he must
return same to the Police.

14.6.3
27/3

开上海赴任新职。
尽管副领事坚持称拉宾是作为潜在买家使用该车，但现有情报显示，副领事将车交给拉宾是为了清偿巨额赌债，这也是他被调离上海的原因。

（批注：涉案金额据称为14,000.00美元 17.6.3）

自从拉宾被剥夺使用该车后，他向朋友宣称，在很短时间内他仍将拥有该车，且该车将悬挂S.D.F.车牌。
已指示该副领事，特别车牌仅供领事官员使用，如果他不再需要使用，必须将其交还警方。

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
Arrest of American Citizen.
At 11.55 a.m. on the 27/12/37, the undersigned, acting on the authority of a Warrant of Arrest, issued by the American Consular Court, apprehended Nathan Rabin, aged 26 years, present occupation, export and import business, present address, 45 Weihaiwei Road, at No. 6 Hongkong Road.
He was escorted by the undersigned, at 2.15 p.m. to Mr. Faupel's office, who directed that he should be photographed and finger printed, which was duly done at the Finger Print Bureau.
He was returned to Mr. Faupel's office, and then released, his lawyer Mr. Allman having put up bail $25. gold.
Although it is not definite, it is understood from Mr. Peterson, of the Court Marshal's Office, that the case against Nathan Rabin, violation of Bye Law 36, and failing to appear on summons, will be heard on the morning of the 31/12/37.
Sen.Det. 1/c.
D.D.O."C".

1937年12月27日上午11时55分，下文署名者依据美国领事法庭签发的逮捕令，在港路6号逮捕了纳森·拉宾，年龄26岁，现职业为进出口生意，现住址为威海卫路45号。
下午2时15分，由下文署名者将其护送至福佩尔（Faupel）先生的办公室，福佩尔先生指示对其拍照并采集指纹，此事已在指纹局妥善办理。
随后他被送回福佩尔先生的办公室，然后获释，其律师奥尔曼（Allman）先生已缴纳25金币保释金。
虽然尚不确定，但从法院法警办公室的彼得森（Peterson）先生处获悉，针对纳森·拉宾违反附例第36条及未按传票出庭的案件，将于1937年12月31日上午审理。
